item.title: Harry Styles Grabs Wembley Stadium Crown as Historic Run Begins: 7 Best Moments
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and fashion. Today, we're talking about Harry Styles, the singer-songwriter who's been making waves with his incredible performances and iconic fashion moments.
Recently, Harry was asked about his most iconic fashion moment, and his answer might surprise you. It was a red loveheart jumpsuit paired with a plain white tee, worn at Wembley Stadium in London in June 2022.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: But what's even more interesting is what Harry said about that moment. He revealed that during that show, he felt a sense of calm and joy, especially when it started raining during his performance of "Sign of the Times." He said, "I remember having a massive smile on my face. I thought, 'How can I ask for any more joy?' I felt so full in that moment. I felt like I was flying."
[Short music pause]
Host: That show was a significant moment for Harry, as it was his first-ever headline performance as a solo artist in an outdoor stadium. And now, he's set to break Wembley Stadium's all-time record for most shows in a calendar year with his 12-run show, part of his Together, Together residency.
[Upbeat music starts]
Host: Harry's connection with Wembley Stadium is undeniable. He's played the stadium multiple times, including three shows with One Direction in 2014 and six shows during his Love On Tour run from 2021-2023. His upcoming shows promise to be just as exciting, with a new tour that features rave-influenced production and nods to Underworld and Orchestral Maneuvers in The Dark.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast today. We can't wait to see what Harry Styles has in store for his fans at Wembley Stadium. Will you be attending one of his shows? Let us know in the comments. Until next time, stay stylish and keep on dancing!
